mechanism: Mebendazole may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing glyburide metabolism variability and affecting glucose control; additionally, mebendazole can cause gastrointestinal effects that may alter glyburide absorption.
action: Monitor blood glucose levels closely during and after mebendazole therapy; consider alternative anthelmintic if possible or adjust glyburide dosing based on glucose monitoring.
